context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 65536). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A abliteration of allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 7.3 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-11-22. CAVEATS: this is the weakest promotion in the batch. One capability row - MMLU 0.578 vs 'Before' 0.560 - with no harness, shot count, eval script or n printed anywhere on the card, from an author whose abliteration cards normally publish only refusal tables. The other five rows are refusal/compliance and three self-graded 100% 'Factual/Reasoning/Coherence' rows that look hand-asserted. Promoted because the rule is literal (same table, base column, strictly higher), not because the evidence is strong.
